# 💫 About Me:
👋 Hi, my name is Menna!<br>🏫 I'm a CSE student at the University of South Florida<br>💻 I'm currently learning about GPU architecture and AI accelerators<br>👩🏻‍💻 My latest project:<br>
- [SIMT GPU Streaming Multiprocessor](https://github.com/menna-fouad/GPGPU-SM): a SystemVerilog GPU SM with 8 resident warps (32 threads/warp), warp scheduling, branch divergence, memory coalescing, and a DDR2 interface across two clock domains, verified by a 10-test full-system integration testbench<br>
    - Currently tested for timing closure and functionality with a real DDR2 Memory Interface.
- [MIPS32](https://github.com/menna-fouad/mips32_pipelined_processor): a 5-stage pipelined MIPS32 core for the Nexys A7 FPGA with write-first register-file bypassing, verified by four self-checking testbenches<br>

🎯 My goal is to work on AI accelerators in an RTL design career <br>
